entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *yawn* I'm so sleepy.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I ended up pullin' an all-nighter[n]once I realized today's the last day[n]of exams.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You? Staying up studying?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nah, I gave up on the exam. I was playin'[n]some games, and then before I knew it, [n]it was morning.
I know that feeling.
You're failing for sure.
How manly.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Bull. You say that, but you prolly just[n]spent the whole night studyin'.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh, it'll be fine. Nobody's expectin'[n]anything of me, so I don't gotta worry[n]about grades.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh, it's what I always do. No matter how[n]many times I fail, nothing's gonna change.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *yawn* Morning...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, look who else is yawnin'.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Exams are almost over, so I thought I'd[n]make one last effort across the finish line.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Impressive, Lady Ann. You're quite[n]different from this stupid monkey I know.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Don't gimme that crap. Your brain's[n]tiny compared to mine.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Size is meaningless if there's[n]nothing inside, you know.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What was that!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ugh, will you please shut up!? You're[n]gonna make me forget everything[n]I memo—

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Am I imagining things?
What's wrong?
You need the bathroom?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? No!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What, you see a groper or something?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No, that's not it. It's... nothing.
